# BinaryRat support

Contact YurilLAB at **support@yurillab.dev** for BinaryRat bugs, deployment questions and licensing inquiries. Include “BinaryRat” in the subject. This is the maintainer’s published product contact. [YurilLAB contact page](https://yurillab.dev/#contact)

For a bug report, include the BinaryRat commit or artifact name, Ghidra version, operating system, tool or plugin involved, and the expected and observed results. A minimal example using a disposable project helps the maintainer reproduce the problem. Keep proprietary binaries, saved investigations and credentials out of the initial report.

Teams that require a response deadline, a supported deployment configuration or a commercial agreement should confirm those terms directly with YurilLAB. For security issues in upstream Ghidra, use its private reporting channel. [Ghidra security policy](https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra/security/policy)
